headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 25, 2026, the portfolio is showing a year-to-date return of 24.37%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.02%. This results in an average alpha of 11.35%, indicating that the portfolio is not only growing in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 45.42%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 9.98%, which still falls short of the benchmark but highlights the relative strength of the overall portfolio. Outperformance against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market volatility, reinforcing the portfolio's resilience in uncertain conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
